Native ID, publication date, explicit closing date, 63-person total and application URL are retained; title, paragraphs and reduced table rows are synthetic.

Its table has 17 rows including header, 15 role rows and total 63; no independent role IDs or role-specific duties justify job splitting. Reduced fixture demonstrates two separate same-name education rows, not the complete real table.
hpu-detail.json.publicationEvidence: Actual data.create_time is 2026年9月30日. Never infer a date from the URL, title graduation year, local clock or homepage mark.
hpu-detail.json.openingEvidence: Actual body explicitly closes recruitment on 2026年10月31日. sign_up_end_time is an event ticket signup field and is never used as a recruitment deadline; is_overdue is also not a recruitment proof.
hpu-detail.json.applicationEvidence: Actual body contains plain https://webhr.shccig.com/webhrN2-zp followed by a Chinese parenthesis. It is a candidate URL only; neither a live form nor availability was checked in this fixture.
hpu-detail.json.attachmentEvidence: Actual docs is empty; file_name_url and content_source_url are empty. doc_id/doc_name/doc_url field names are evidenced only by the native #tmpl_details loop. Any nonempty-doc test is synthetic metadata and does not claim a downloaded, extracted or live-observed attachment.
